purpose: MaleCNS v1.0 population registry audit; no calibration and no model outcome

rules.cx_dan: official dopamine anatomical candidates whose syn-partners primary_post fraction in EB, PB, FB, NO, LAL(L), or LAL(R) is at least 0.2; these labels represent the seven FlyWire CX compartments because MaleCNS collapses bilateral NO to one ROI label
rules.cx_dan_roi_analogue: MaleCNS counts each released postsynaptic partner synapse by its own primary_post ROI. FlyWire instead multiplies each aggregate pair by the postsynaptic cell's compartment-targeting weights, so this is the closest released-ROI analogue, not the same numerator construction.
rules.edge_scope: every official globally aggregated directed pair between graph nodes; no weight cut (item 150)
rules.er_trace_set: ER registry candidates (^ER\d) with any direct aggregate TuBu pair; this is the FlyWire trace-set rule
rules.laterality: somaSide, then rootSide; L/R become left/right; null side selects all annotated sides
rules.mn9: type MN9 on the FlyWire source's right side and pharyngeal nerve
rules.node_scope: status Traced and non-null MaleCNS type, matching the declared adapter graph
rules.outcome_blinding: All memberships use released anatomy/labels/connectivity only; no firing or downstream outcome was inspected.
rules.sugar: do not assign an unlabeled labellar gustatory candidate to sugar; flywireType is a type label, not a root-level FlyWire cross-match
rules.untyped_motor: exclude from the typed/traced graph and populations because no released type establishes motor identity beyond broad class

sources.citation: Berg et al. 2026, Cell, Sexual dimorphism in the complete Drosophila male central nervous system connectome
sources.use: MaleCNS anatomy, official types, sides, nerve and ROI annotations
checksummed official v1.0 annotation, transmitter, aggregate-connectivity and synapse tables

sugar_reflex.MN9_rule: right MN9 on PhN, matching FlyWire laterality and nerve
sugar_reflex.cross_match_check: flywireType provides type-level labels only; the release has no FlyWire root-ID column. No labellar candidate has receptorType.
sugar_reflex.reason: MaleCNS types labellar gustatory cells and their entry nerve, but supplies no sugar modality or receptor label and no root-level FlyWire cross-match. Port step 7 has no sugar-reflex source until one is established.
